senses.gloss: one who uses the vowel letters freely, who writes plene, opp. בַּצִּירָא.
Tos’faah, surname of one Raba or Rabbah; [Neub. Géogr. p. 332: of Thospia, capital of the Armenian district Thospitis].
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 80b:2">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 50a:15">Ber. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 95a:5">Sabb. 95ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 4a:22">M. Kat. 4ᵃ</cite>
